name: LoomWard · 织盾

title.zh: LoomWard · 织盾 · 基于 Cordis 内核的综合本地 Agent 安全管控平台
title.en: LoomWard · Cordis-Based Local Agent Security & Control Plane

summary.zh: 基于 Cordis 4 微内核与 pnpm monorepo 构建的个人综合 Agent 管控平台，融合 Cloudflare OAuth 2.1 远程中继、原生流式安全审查、本机逐参人工审批、只读 Linux Docker 沙箱、第三方 MCP 聚合、防泄漏与多模态 LLM 内容审查及人机决策台账。
summary.en: Cordis 4 monorepo local Agent control plane unifying Cloudflare OAuth 2.1 remote MCP relay, native streaming moderation, exact local approval, read-only Linux Docker sandboxes, third-party MCP aggregation, anti-leak & multimodal LLM content moderation, and a decision ledger.

zh: 以 Cordis 4 + 冻结根插件清单（RPM）+ KernelGuard + PolicyTree 为安全微内核，机械守卫包间分层，锁定 tool:invoke@1 与 tool:stream@1 单调阻断不变量及按 caller 隔离的 plugin:secrets@1 密钥绑定
提供单源统一回环安全控制台（默认 127.0.0.1:18797：PassKey/强密码、逐参两步审批、能力总熔断、只写插件密钥托管、Ollama 本地运行时管理与安全策略配置、按客户端及全局阈值提示脱敏注入告警、SSE 实时审计与零 JS 注入声明式 console:panel@1），承载 ContentInspect v2 独立/合并/原生流式审查协议

整合远程桥接、R1–R7 离线防泄漏护栏（@loomward/plugin-antileak）、多模态 LLM 内容审查（@loomward/plugin-llm-moderation：原生 Ollama Guard + 防诱导金丝雀探针 + 四大云端审核 API + 分块暂留流控）与人机决策台账（@loomward/plugin-decisions），并通过 @loomward/plugin-adapters 对接 CloudForge 与 ModelBridge
en: Powered by a Cordis 4 microkernel with frozen Root Plugin Manifests (RPM), KernelGuard, PolicyTree, mechanical layering checks, monotonic tool:invoke@1 / tool:stream@1 safety latches, and caller-bound plugin:secrets@1 namespaces

Delivers a single-origin unified loopback console (127.0.0.1:18797: PassKey/password auth, two-step exact approval, kill switches, write-only plugin secret vault, moderation policy controls, redacted prompt injection alerts with per-client and global thresholds, live SSE telemetry, and zero-JS declarative console:panel@1) alongside ContentInspect v2

Unifies remote bridge, offline R1–R7 anti-leak guardrails (@loomward/plugin-antileak), multimodal LLM content moderation (@loomward/plugin-llm-moderation with Local Guard, Canary Inducement Probe, 4 cloud safety APIs, and holdback streaming), decision ledger (@loomward/plugin-decisions), and CloudForge/ModelBridge adapters

quickStart: pnpm run build:console && pnpm run check && pnpm run layering

milestone.zh: 已完成 Cordis 4 微内核平台重构、十轮对抗性安全审查收敛、多模态 LLM 内容审查插件（Local Guard + 金丝雀防诱导探针 + 云端 API + 原生 Holdback 流式审查）及单源统一安全控制台整合。
milestone.en: Completed the Cordis 4 microkernel monorepo architecture, 10 rounds of adversarial security hardening, the multimodal LLM content moderation plugin (Local Guard + Canary Probe + Cloud APIs + native holdback streaming), and the single-origin unified console.
